questions.question_text: An amount of $\$1800$ is invested at $5\%$ p.a. simple interest for $3$ years. Choose the correct graph to draw for its total investment value. Each option describes a straight line segment, with time in years horizontally and investment value vertically.

options.why: Plotted interest earned instead of total investment value.
Added only one year's interest of $\$90$ at year $3$.
Used $0.005$ instead of $0.05$, giving yearly interest of $\$9$.
